title.value: Towards the Neuroevolution of Low-Level Artificial General Intelligence
title.justification: The title of the paper is directly taken from the beginning of the document, providing a clear indication of the topic discussed.

extractions.description: This paper explores the development of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) from a low-level perspective, relying on neuroevolution techniques. The framework, named Neuroevolution of Artificial General Intelligence (NAGI), is utilized to evolve biologically-inspired spiking neural networks with adaptive synapses. These networks control agents in mutable environments to benchmark adaptability and generality. The paper evaluates NAGI on tasks like food foraging, logic gate emulation, and cart-pole balancing.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on the development of AGI using neuroevolution and adaptive synapses, without explicitly addressing climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Our hypothesis is that learning occurs through interpreting sensory feedback when an agent acts in an environment. For that to happen, a body and a reactive environment are needed.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address any specific climate change mitigation, adaptation, or ecological protection issues. It is focused on AGI development.
primary_category.quote: The circumstances of intelligent behavior in nature resulted from an organism interacting with its surrounding environment, which could change over time and exert pressure on the organism.

secondary_categories.justification: No secondary climate-related topics are discussed; the paper is dedicated exclusively to AGI and neuroevolution processes.
secondary_categories.quote: We evaluate a method to evolve a biologically-inspired artificial neural network that learns from environment reactions named Neuroevolution of Artificial General Intelligence (NAGI), a framework for low-level AGI.

primary_sub_category.justification: There are no mentions of sub-categories related to climate or ecological sustainability, as the focus is on AGI.
primary_sub_category.quote: The framework, named Neuroevolution of Artificial General Intelligence (NAGI), enables the evolution of neural networks with adaptive synapses.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper does not explore any sub-categories relevant to climate-related themes; it is centered on AI and neural network evolution.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The chosen tasks in the mutable environments are food foraging, emulation of logic gates, and cart-pole balancing.

new_primary_category.justification: The content and intent of the paper revolve around advancing AGI through new neuroevolution methods, which is not covered by the existing climate-related categories.
new_primary_category.quote: Our hypothesis is that learning occurs through interpreting sensory feedback when an agent acts in an environment.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The focus on using neuroevolutionary methods to develop low-level AGI is unique to this paper and not covered by existing sub-categories.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: This method allows the evolutionary complexification of a randomly-initialized spiking neural network with adaptive synapses.
